items.titleEn: BR: It's been 22 years since the Asian Man of the Year award went to Iran, and I hope that's over.
items.summaryEn: Tractor goalkeeper Alirsa Biranund, one of the three finalists for the Asian Footballer of the Year award, expressed hope that after 22 years the award will once again be awarded to Iran's representatives.
